Neither `consecutive_clean` nor `open` delivers that separation. A role is clean in a round only when every one of its rows is PASS, so a lens regenerating new findings and a lens carrying an unfixed stable set are BOTH non-clean in every round and BOTH report `consecutive_clean: 0` forever — the two states the paragraph names produce identical output. For any role that holds open rows, `consecutive_clean` is therefore a restatement of `open > 0` (they are logically equivalent by construction, since every entry has rows in the latest round), i.e. one duplicated bit per entry. Discriminating new-vs-stale would require comparing the finding *sets* across rounds, which this release does not do. The array's per-entry cost is thus paid against a benefit the spec cannot deliver.
